import os
import shutil
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('project-tasks')
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('TASKS_DB', 'tasks.db')
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get('SMTP_HOST', 'localhost')
TEAM_WEBHOOK = os.environ['TEAM_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK']
ATTACH_DIR = os.environ.get('TASK_ATTACHMENTS_DIR', 'attachments')

def _load_task(task_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute('SELECT t.title, t.due_date, u.email, u.name FROM tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = ?', (task_id,)).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError(f'Task {task_id} not found')
    return {'title': row[0], 'due': row[1], 'email': row[2], 'name': row[3]}

@mcp.tool()
def notify_assignee_of_overdue_task(task_id: int, extra_message: str='') -> str:
    task = _load_task(task_id)
    body = f"Hi {task['name']},\n\nTask #{task_id} '{task['title']}' was due on {task['due']} and is still open.\n"
    if extra_message:
        body += f'\n{extra_message}\n'
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['Subject'] = f"Overdue: {task['title']}"
    msg['From'] = 'tasks@example.com'
    msg['To'] = task['email']
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    # Move the task's attachment folder into the overdue area
    src = os.path.join(ATTACH_DIR, str(task_id))
    if os.path.isdir(src):
        dest_root = os.path.join(ATTACH_DIR, 'overdue')
        os.makedirs(dest_root, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(src, os.path.join(dest_root, str(task_id)))
    resp = requests.post(TEAM_WEBHOOK, json={'event': 'task_overdue_reminder', 'task_id': task_id, 'assignee': task['email']}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Reminder emailed to {task['email']} and team webhook notified"
